findings.evidence: `Restriction/Delta.lean:258` already proves the identical `res`/`δ` equation for arbitrary `r` under `0 ≤ r`; `AllDegrees.lean:54,67` identifies `res` at `0` and `-1` with `H0Res` and `HNegOneRes`, so the new theorem supplies exactly the sole missing case for `-1 ≤ r`.
findings.fix: Generalize `δ_comp_res` to assume `-1 ≤ r`, dispatching `r = -1` to this proof and the nonnegative case to the existing argument; derive the normalized `HNegOneRes`/`H0Res` boundary lemma as a corollary if it is useful for simp.
findings.issue: `δ_comp_res_neg_one` leaves the API split between one boundary degree and the existing uniform theorem for `0 ≤ r`, rather than stating the available general range.

summary: The boundary result is exposed only as a special case even though it readily extends the existing uniform restriction theorem to the natural range `-1 ≤ r`.
